10.06.2026 WPSB No. 332 of 2026
Om Singh ---- petitioner
Vs
State of Uttarakhand & ors ---- respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J. 
1. Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. J.C. Pande and Mr. Sachin Mohan 
Singh Mehta, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State / respondent Nos. 1 to 4.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for 
and is granted time to bring on record the order 
by which Chief Education Officer has approved 
the appointment of the petitioner on the post of 
Officiating Principal / attested his signatures as 
such.
4. List next week.
5. Meanwhile, learned State counsel shall 
obtain instructions in the matter. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
